source_instruction: i am looking fresh scent body lotion for dry skin.
query: Ugh, I swear the community garden plot I signed up for this spring is out to get me this week. I stopped by to water my tomato plants first thing this morning and found a whole family of squirrels had dug up half my marigold seedlings to stash acorns, and one of them just sat on the fence chittering at me like I was the one intruding on their space. I tried to patch up the bed and replant what I could save, but I tracked so much clumpy mud across the sidewalk on my walk home that a kid on a scooter pointed and laughed at my caked-up sneakers the whole block. Hey, I’m looking through the body care section right now for something that works for combination skin, I want it to have that nice fresh scent too, and oh it’d be great if it came with a little loofah attachment bundled with it. Can you show me options that fit what I’m looking for? I don’t want to spend too much, just something that fits my budget, y’know? I’ve been scrolling for a few minutes and haven’t found the right pick yet.

extras.text: came with a little loofah attachment bundled with it
